g.text: Forebrain validation across mice, reference transcripts and RNA depth
Eight independent mice; age-balanced flight comparisons. All results come from complete 151-target analysis families.
A: bars span eight deletion estimates; they are not confidence intervals. B/C: 95% HC3 model intervals; filled points indicate corrected q < 0.05.
B: reference = geometric mean of Csf1r, Tmem119, P2ry12, Hexb and Sall1 (biological denominators, not assumed stable housekeeping genes).
C: analytical rarefaction followed by mouse-level inference. These checks do not remove processing-day confounding or establish protein activity.
